summary: The diff addresses REQ-1 by updating the frontend upload flow (useQueries.ts, Upload.tsx) to implement a two-step upload process that correctly parses the UploadResponse discriminated union from the backend, and updates backend/main.mo to include the necessary blob-storage mixin. The changes appear to cover the core requirement of fixing the 'expected v3 response body' error.

hallucinated_features.description: Progress tracking callbacks (onMediaProgress/onThumbnailProgress) added to the upload mutation params
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked to fix the v3 response body parsing error. Adding per-step progress tracking for media and thumbnail uploads was not requested.
